_comment: THE DIALECT FIXTURE the node's tests drive the node-axis plane with (root/tests/plane_node.rs).
Data, not code (ARCHITECT F-T): the dialect names, each dialect's native request body and the
customer-visible facts its URL carries live here, so the test source names no vendor. Every
dialect named here is resolved against the linked table the root installs (`crate::LINKED`),
so a row for a dialect the plane no longer declares fails the test that reads it.
path_model: the URL-model dialects, one row each, in the linked path table's order:
body -- the native request body (the model is in the URL, so one body serves every fixture);
json_array_when_streamed -- a streamed request on this dialect's URL takes the JSON-array framing;
model_not_found -- the dialect's own miss copy for a model the URL named ({model} is the name),
or null for the neutral sentence;
over_budget_status -- the status the door's over-budget turn-away answers in this dialect.
body_model: each body-model dialect's native request body; the test adds the `model` member.
rerank: the upstream provider the rerank lane is configured with, and the URL-model dialect

path_model.model_not_found: models/{model} is not found for API version v1beta, or is not supported for the task you are trying to perform.
